title: Got a bad item
text: Got a bad item. I can't rate this item.  Unfortunately, I did not check this out when I received it.  I bought it to use for Christmas. I just got it out of the box and it doesn't work.  So disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Twinkle Star 100 LED Lighted White Birch Branches 2 Pack Artificial Branches Waterproof Battery Operated with Timer for Indoor Outdoor Christmas Wedding Party Home Decoration (Vase Excluded)
features: Artificial White Birch Branches with Lights: These flexible branches feature 100 warm white LED lights on branches, LED lighted white branch will add a sparkle of light to any floral arrangement, plant or centerpiece. (NOT INCLUDE VASE)

Best House Decoration: Each lighted artificial branches can be used as a unique table decoration in any season. Perfect decor for home, fireplace, living room, kitchen, balcony, office room, restaurant, porch.
Great Idea Present: It is an ideal gift for friends and family. Not only for Christmas party, but also for Thanksgiving day, Birthday, Wedding Ceremony, Dinner Party Decoration and so on.

Battery Operated: 3 AA Batteries requires, not include batteries. The artificial branches has on/off/timer modes. Set timer for 6 hours on and 18 hours off per day. Battery box are IP44 waterproof, it is perfect for indoor and outdoor use.
